name: Triple-barrier meta-labeled momentum (spot)
rationale: Meta-labeling (Lopez de Prado): keep the PRIMARY signal deliberately permissive — bare time-series momentum (ret over a fitted lookback above a low floor) decides only the SIDE (long spot) — and hand the act/skip decision to a SECONDARY regularized-logistic classifier. The secondary is trained, expanding-window and point-in-time, on which of the three barriers (stop-loss / take-profit / time) each past momentum entry hit first, netted of cost (win=1 else 0), reading momentum strength, RSI, realized vol and perp funding at entry. It only SIZES/SKIPS, never flips direction. HONEST PRIOR: meta-labeling can only amplify an edge the primary already has; spot momentum after ~20bps round-trip has shown none in prior gates, so the expected outcome is a powered FAIL that closes the spot-only book — this spec exists to run that test cleanly, not because a pass is expected.
catalyst: secondary model green-lights a momentum entry in a regime where the signal has historically paid
